lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There. We made it to the dock. How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: You seriously carried me up here...? I didn't think I'd make it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I wasn't leaving you hurt down there.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: Wait a second. Why do I have feet? ...What happened to my fins?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I think you changed when we came out of the water. Let's get you a place to recover.

lines.speaker: barracuda
lines.text: ...Yeah. Thanks, Penni. I owe you one.
